AND p.end_date < CURDATE() AND p.status != 'COMPLETED'

SELECT p.project_id, p.project_name, p.description, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.budget, p.status, d.department_name, e.name as manager_name, e.email as manager_email, COUNT(DISTINCT pe.employee_id) as team_size, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.milestone_id) as milestone_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completed_milestones, ROUND(AVG(pe.contribution_rate), 2) as avg_contribution_rate, DATEDIFF(IFNULL(p.end_date, CURDATE()), p.start_date) as total_duration, CASE WHEN p.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 100 WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT pm.milestone_id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN pm.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT pm.milestone_id)), 2) END as completion_percentage FROM project p LEFT JOIN department d ON p.department_id = d.department_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON p.manager_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN project_employee pe ON p.project_id = pe.project_id LEFT JOIN project_milestone pm ON p.project_id = pm.project_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_name, p.description, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.budget, p.status, d.department_name, e.name, e.email
